# Erset Platform

> Erset (a brand of Set Platform Makine İnşaat San. Tic. Ltd. Şti.) is a Turkish
> manufacturer of construction lifting equipment, producing since 1986. Erset builds
> mast-climbing platform scaffolding (ERP series) and passenger/material construction
> hoists (ERY series), exporting to more than 15 countries. Key engineering strengths:
> patented mechanical parachute safety brakes, high-torque planetary drive systems,
> high-strength masts, modular cabins and fault-display control systems.

## Products — Platform Scaffolding (ERP series)
- [ERP 1050 — Single-tower work platform](https://erset.com.tr/en/urunler/erp-1050): 1,000 kg capacity, up to 120 m, 10.5 m platform.
- [ERP 3000 — Dual-tower work platform](https://erset.com.tr/en/urunler/erp-3000): 3,000 kg capacity, up to 120 m, 30 m platform.
- [ERP 4000 — Dual-tower work platform](https://erset.com.tr/en/urunler/erp-4000): 3,000 kg capacity, up to 200 m, 40 m platform.

## Products — Hoists (ERY series)
- [ERY 250 — Material hoist](https://erset.com.tr/en/urunler/ery-250): 250 kg, 2 persons, up to 100 m.
- [ERY 1500-450 — Material hoist](https://erset.com.tr/en/urunler/ery-1500-450): 1,500 kg, 15 persons, up to 200 m.
- [ERY 2000-450 — Material hoist](https://erset.com.tr/en/urunler/ery-2000-450): 2,000 kg, 22 persons, up to 200 m.
- [ERY 2000-650 — Material hoist](https://erset.com.tr/en/urunler/ery-2000-650): 2,000 kg, reinforced mast, triple-motor.
- [ERY 2500-650 — Passenger & material hoist](https://erset.com.tr/en/urunler/ery-2500-650): 2,500 kg, up to 250 m.
- [ERY 3000-4000-5000 — Heavy material hoist](https://erset.com.tr/en/urunler/ery-3000-4000-5000): 3,000–5,000 kg capacity range.
